decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine is a multi-model line built directly on the firm's core precast automation engineering and its own R&D. That gives management strong absorptive capacity to read early results and refine the product, even though the earlier robots were consolidated.

Production analysis software sits close to the firm's established control and planning capabilities and is cheap to maintain. It also generates customer data the firm can readily assimilate to improve its integrated plant solutions.
